entries.title: Amulet and Charta Effects
entries.summary: How charges are expended when an amulet is worn or a charta is made, and what effects are not allowed for these devices.

entries.title: Learned Magician Laboratory Requirements
entries.summary: A learned magician's laboratory needs only the basic equipment for casting a horoscope and writing.

entries.title: Learned Magician Laboratory Texts
entries.summary: Lab Texts follow the Hermetic rules but charms are shorter, so many more charm levels can be written or copied per season than device levels.
quotes: Language x 100 charm levels per season Language x 20 device levels per season

entries.title: Inventing and Learning New Charms
entries.summary: Charms are learned from a teacher and invented by the Hermetic rules, but the totals are multiplied because charms are simpler.
quotes: the maximum total levels of charms learned in a season is the teacher's Lab Total in the applicable Art combination multiplied by five

entries.title: Mythic Alchemist Magic
entries.summary: How mythic alchemists work: powders, potions and pastilles in place of charms, Philosophiae in the Lab Total, experimentation risk, vis cost for doses, lab assistance rules, and a Warping progression leading to paranoia and insanity.
quotes: A Mythic alchemist substitutes his Philosophiae score for Artes Liberales in calculating his Lab Total.
the alchemist must use 1 pawn of vis for every 5 levels of the base effect of the potion
When the character's Warping Score reaches 3, he acquires a Minor Personality Flaw making the character more secretive and suspicious.

entries.title: Arcane Ability Fertility Lore
entries.summary: A non-supernatural Arcane Ability checked by visual inspection to detect pregnancy, due date, kinship and fertility, using Perception rolls whose Ease Factors depend on what is being determined.
quotes: A roll of Perception + Fertility Lore against an Ease Factor of 3 indicates whether a character is pregnant
A roll of Perception + Fertility Lore against an Ease Factor of 12 reveals whether a character (male or female) is fertile
increase the Ease Factors listed here by 3

entries.title: The Fertility Ritual
entries.summary: A Lab activity of one season that produces a Lab Text for a conception ritual: the Creo Corpus Lab Total sets the Trait Points available, each chosen trait has a Trait Point cost, and performing it consumes vis equal to the points spent and takes parents who are both fertile.
quotes: Maximum Trait Points: 1 for every 10 points or fraction of Creo Corpus Lab Total
developing the ritual is a Laboratory activity that takes one season
Conducting the Fertility Ritual consumes an amount of vis equal to the total Trait Point cost of the desired traits.

entries.title: The Maga's Own Child
entries.summary: A maga devising a Fertility Ritual for her own child gets more Trait Points per Creo Corpus Lab Total, but the ritual is then tied to her and cannot be used for another mother.
quotes: the maximum number of Trait Points for the ritual is equal to 1 for every 5 points, or fraction thereof, of Creo Corpus Lab Total

entries.title: Balancing Traits
entries.summary: Traits given by a Fertility Ritual need not balance, but a troupe is advised to let a player-character child gain balancing Virtues or Flaws as he ages.

entries.title: Supernatural Traits
entries.summary: Parents' traits are irrelevant to a Fertility Ritual, but the magus can only grant supernatural traits from realms he has a connection to, and the Gift connects him to the Magic realm.
quotes: the magus can only develop a ritual granting powers that derive from realms he has a connection to

entries.title: Fertility Fetishes
entries.summary: A mother-made fetish, built over a season under supervision by someone with Fertility Lore, adds to the Lab Total for a Fertility Ritual limited to her own child, holds a pawn of Creo vis, and is a permanent Arcane Connection to mother and children.
quotes: Fertility Fetish Lab Total Bonus: mother's (Dex + Craft Ability) + supervisor's Fertility Lore Ability
may supervise a number of mothers, per season, equal to up to his Leadership Ability Score

entries.title: Repeating a Fertility Ritual
entries.summary: Repeating a ritual is only safe if the original child died; otherwise the magus gains Warping Points that may cause Twilight and the new child bears the Corrupt Fertility Ritual Flaw.
quotes: the magus immediately gains a number of Warping Points equal to half the Trait Point cost of the ritual (round up)

entries.title: Cave Systems
entries.summary: A Perception plus Area Lore roll finds a cave used by the ancient fertility cult, if the storyguide has placed one in the area, and the section describes typical cave layout and surviving fetish figurines.
quotes: To Find a Suitable Cave System: Per + Area Lore vs. Ease Factor 18

entries.title: Cave Painting Galleries
entries.summary: Cave galleries depicting fertility rituals can be studied for Insight and give Lab Total bonuses to Creo Corpus work, reduced if the paintings are moved; hunting paintings give an Animal bonus, copies are useless, and removing a painting needs a mason's roll.
quotes: provides a +3 bonus to Creo Corpus Lab Totals (including during the development of a Fertility Ritual)
A mundane mason can successfully remove a cave painting on a Dexterity + Craft Masonry stress roll against an Ease Factor of 15

entries.title: Ritual Items (charged items with ritual effects)
entries.summary: Explains how charged items holding ritual effects work: each charge costs the vis the ritual would normally cost, with the usual seasonal vis limit and charge calculation.
quotes: Each charge requires the same number of pawns of vis that casting the effect normally would otherwise cost.

related.text: ArM5 p.133 Curse of the Unportended Plague

entries.title: Confluence of the Realms (realm-swapping lab texts, vis extraction)
entries.requires: Virtue: Confluence of the Realms (Hermetic, researched or integrated)
entries.summary: Lets a maga change the realm named in a spell or device laboratory text when she uses it in the laboratory, and extract vis from any of the four realms using the usual extraction rules modified by aura. Explains the extended laboratory and vis rules behind the Virtue and its research-point cost.
quotes: can be changed during any subsequent use of that lab text
It takes 30 research points to integrate this Virtue.

entries.title: List of Artifacts (integration points for Conciatta's Virtues)
entries.requires: Studying Conciatta's artifacts and lab texts to integrate her Virtues
entries.summary: A table listing each spell or device found in the Four Corners story, which of Conciatta's Virtues it inspires, and how many integration or breakthrough points it provides.
quotes: the integration/breakthrough points that each provides

entries.title: Insight from Conciatta's devices and laboratory texts
entries.summary: Explains that each noted laboratory text or device gives a bonus to the insight roll equal to the effect's magnitude, and that only the highest-level effect on a multi-effect device provides insight.
quotes: equal to the magnitude of the effect. Where a device is enchanted with more than one effect, only the highest level effect provides insight.

entries.title: Aftermath: further Hermetic Breakthroughs from Conciatta's work
entries.summary: Describes the next possible Hermetic Breakthrough, letting Vim spells affect every realm without re-invention, and how owning Conciatta's Virtues lowers it to a Major Breakthrough, plus a further Major Breakthrough to fully integrate her work for all magi.
quotes: possession of Conciatta's Virtues lays the groundwork and, with troupe approval, reduces this level of integration to a Major Breakthrough

entries.title: The Garden as a Source of Breakthrough
entries.summary: Explains how magi can recreate Hérisson's Breakthroughs by studying his surviving inventions as Insight sources, using Hermetic Investigation in place of a Magic Theory roll and earning Breakthrough points by duplicating the effects; Stirpes count as level 15 enchantments.
quotes: Each Stirps should be considered to be an enchantment of Level 15
earning Breakthrough points equal to the magnitude of the effect created

related.text: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages p.26 Original Research
ArM5 p.162 Gather the Essence of the Beast

entries.title: Laboratory Texts from the Garden (sidebar)
entries.summary: Optional rule that Hérisson's laboratory texts for his Original Research yield Breakthrough points when studied by recreating the experiment.
quotes: Each of his Hermetic creations provides Breakthrough Points equal to the magnitude of the effect once it has been studied by recreating the experiment

related.text: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages p.29

entries.title: Insight into Original Research (Purgatory)
entries.requires: Access to Purgatory sources of insight
entries.summary: How a magus studies the Mirror of Souls, the Fountain of Youth or the Furnace for a season to gain an insight for original research, and the roll needed.
quotes: make an Intelligence + Magic Theory stress roll against an Ease Factor of 18
The Inventive Genius Virtue adds 3 to this roll.

related.text: Hedge Magic Revised Edition p.14 Insight

entries.title: Researching a Way to Affect the Magic Realm (Breakthrough and Insight)
entries.summary: Research procedure for a Minor Breakthrough allowing spells that reach the Magic Realm: gain Insight Points from diseased vis and slain Magic creatures, invent Intellego Vim effects to earn Breakthrough Points, and accumulate enough to integrate the new magic, which then acts as an Arcane Connection.
quotes: To integrate spells that affect the Magic Realm the researcher needs 30 Breakthrough points
Each rotted pawn of vis provides 1 insight point, as does each magnitude of Might of a dead Magic creature.

related.text: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages pp.26-30 original research

entries.title: Hermetic Alchemy — Hermetic Minor Virtue
entries.summary: Overview of the Virtue that lets a magus extract more vis, or Form-specific vis, in the laboratory.
quotes: Hermetic Alchemy lets the magus extract more vis from an aura, or to extract Form-specific vis rather than Vim vis.

entries.title: Improved Extraction of Vis
entries.summary: Lab Total for extracting vis using a crafted receptacle with Shape and Material Bonuses, and the number of pawns of Vim vis yielded.
quotes: Alchemical Vis Extraction Lab Total = Creo + Vim + Intelligence + Magic Theory + Aura Modifier + Shape and Material Bonuses
Vim Vis Extracted = one-tenth (round up) of Vis Extraction Lab Total

entries.title: Form-Specific Vis
entries.summary: Extracting Form-specific vis rather than Vim vis halves the yield, uses a Form requisite for the Creo Vim Lab Total, and cannot produce Technique vis.
quotes: Form-specific Vis Extraction Lab Total = Creo + Vim (Form requisite) + Intelligence + Magic Theory + Aura Modifier + Shape and Material Bonuses
Form Vis Extracted = one-twentieth (round up) of Vis Extraction Lab Total

entries.title: Choosing Appropriate Shape and Material Factors
entries.summary: How to pick which Shape and Material Bonuses apply to a vis extraction by imagining a single invested effect of the desired Form, with the total bonus capped by Magic Theory.
quotes: but the total Shape and Material Bonus is limited by the magus's Magic Theory score

entries.title: Philosophic Alchemy — Minor and Major Mystery Virtue
entries.summary: Lets an alchemical object digest on its own so vis is extracted (or ready-opened enchantment spaces created) with little attention; the Minor Virtue needs a year and the Major Virtue a single season.
quotes: Minor Philosophic Alchemy requires a year (four continuous seasons) of fermentation and digestion
Major Philosophic Alchemy allows a more efficient digestion to be established, which is completed in a single season.

entries.title: Automatic Extraction of Vis
entries.summary: A settled extraction counts as a seven-day distraction from other lab work, may run alongside other lab activities, and is ruined if distractions exceed 20 days.
quotes: treating the vis extraction as a seven-day distraction from other lab work
if the distractions exceed 20 days, the digestion is spoiled and must be abandoned

entries.title: Time Needed for Automatic Extraction of Vis
entries.summary: Minor Philosophic Alchemy runs for four seasons and the vis extracted is based on the lowest of the four Lab Totals; only one extraction can run per season and experimentation spoils it.
quotes: the vis extracted is determined by the lowest of the four Lab Totals
A magus may only manage a single vis extraction in any season

entries.title: Ready-Opened Devices
entries.summary: Philosophic Alchemy can instead produce a device with already-opened enchantment spaces, equal in number to the pawns of Vim vis that would have been extracted.
quotes: The number of spaces open is equal to the number of pawns of Vim vis that would have been extracted into it as automatic vis extraction.

entries.title: Automata
entries.summary: Introduces the Major Mystery that grants the Craft Automata Ability and the three stages of building an automaton (body, spirit, mind); other Hermetic magi can learn it as a Supernatural Ability.
quotes: Knowing this Mystery grants the Major Hermetic Virtue Craft Automata, an Ability with an initial score of 1.

related.text: ArM5 p.166 Study Totals for Supernatural Abilities

entries.title: Creating an Automaton
entries.summary: Stage one of automaton construction: choose a species and material to get its Magic Might, pay a vis-equivalent cost in Mythic Pounds, and make an Intelligence + Craft Automata roll with a growing bonus after each failed season.
quotes: Magic MigHt: 10 + Size + Material Base Points
Intelligence + Craft Automata + stress die vs. Automaton's Magic Might

related.text: ArM5 p.97 Material and Size Table

entries.title: Preparing an Automaton for Enchantment
entries.summary: Stage two: opening the constructed automaton for enchantment by spending Vim vis equal to its Magic Might in a single season; the result is a greater enchanted item that cannot be a talisman.
quotes: This takes a number of pawns of Vim vis equal to the automaton's Magic Might score.

entries.title: Enchanting an Automaton
entries.summary: Stage three: instilling spell-like and Ability-like powers into an automaton, with fixed Range and Target, no Concentration Duration, a 'Cease' command, a vis limit equal to Magic Might, and a list of common automaton powers.
quotes: the maximum number of pawns an automaton can hold equals its Magic Might score
Each power instilled requires one pawn of vis for every ten levels of the power's final effect, rounded up.
This effect adds +3 to the final level of the effect.

entries.title: The Construction Combined (Tie the Threads That Bind)
entries.summary: The final step in making an automaton: casting the ritual Rego Vim spell Tie the Threads that Bind, whose level must exceed the automaton's Magic Might by a set margin.
quotes: This spell's level must equal or exceed the finished construct's Magic Might + 15.

entries.title: Automata in Play
entries.summary: How finished automata act (simple die only, no great successes or botches), the yearly maintenance roll against Magic Might, penalties from lost Might, and spot or seasonal repairs.
quotes: At the end of every year, roll a stress die and compare it to the automaton's Magic Might score.
Ease Factor of (6 + the magnitude of the automaton's Magic Might score)

entries.title: Gruagach Laboratory Activities
entries.summary: Lists the few laboratory activities open to gruagachan and the gruagach Lab Total, which uses Pictish Language in place of Magic Theory.
quotes: Gruagach Technique + Gruagach Form + Intelligence + Pictish Language + Aura Modifier

entries.title: Gruagach Learning and Inventing Spells
entries.summary: Gruagachan learn and invent spells by the Hermetic rules.

entries.title: Enchanting Tattoos
entries.summary: Rules for gruagach tattoos, which work as Lesser Enchantments: size multipliers for material, Blessing tattoos, Warping, shape bonuses, plus a worked example.
quotes: A tattoo has a base material score of 2, multiplied by a size modifier.

entries.title: Gruagach Shape Bonuses
entries.summary: Table of animal shapes for gruagach tattoos and the shape bonus each animal gives to particular kinds of effect.
quotes: Boar: +3 ferocity, + 4 attacking
Dove: +6 granting visions or premonitions

entries.title: Gruagach Vis Use
entries.summary: How gruagachan use and study raw vis, which Hermetic Forms of vis suit each gruagach Art, extracting Vim vis from auras and moving vis between physical forms.
quotes: A gruagach may extract a number of pawns of Vim vis from a magical aura equal to one tenth of her Take Vision Lab Total.
The gruagach is limited in the number of pawns he may use in a single season to twice his score in Pictish Language.

entries.title: Gruagach Laboratory Texts
entries.summary: Gruagach Laboratory Texts follow the Hermetic rules but Pictish replaces Latin for the levels writable per season, and texts are written in Ogham.
quotes: it replaces Latin to determine the number of levels that may be written per season

entries.title: Vulgar Alchemy — Minor Hermetic Mystery Virtue
entries.summary: Introduces Vulgar Alchemy, which lets a magus experiment with new components during enchantment to discover personal Shape and Material Bonuses; it cannot be used on invested devices but works for charged and lesser enchanted devices.
quotes: Vulgar Alchemy is not usable on invested devices

entries.title: The Experiment
entries.summary: How to begin a Vulgar Alchemy enchantment season: choose components up to the limit of Magic Theory, complete the enchantment and determine the Experimentation Bonus.
quotes: The magus may choose any number of components up to the limit of his Magic Theory score
Experimentation Bonus = Simple Die roll + Risk Modifier

entries.title: Repeated Experiments to Determine a Category
entries.summary: Suggested formula for how many successful tests a component needs to establish a bonus covering a broader category, by scope.
quotes: 3 x proposed bonus score, plus a scope factor:
+15 if the scope is a single Hermetic Technique

entries.title: Testing the Components
entries.summary: How the Experimentation Bonus is divided among components, with a Perception + Magic Lore roll for each untested component against an Ease Factor based on the proposed bonus.
quotes: Simple Die + Perception + Magic Lore vs. an Ease Factor of 3 + (3 x proposed Material or Shape Bonus)

entries.title: Final Result
entries.summary: The Vulgar Alchemy Lab Total for the experimental enchantment and for repeating it without experimentation, and what a Lab Text conveys to others.
quotes: Intelligence + Magic Theory + Technique + Form + Aura + Magic Lore + Experimentation Bonus + Successful Component Bonuses
Intelligence + Magic Theory + Technique + Form + Aura + Magic Lore + Component Bonuses

entries.title: The Bonuses
entries.summary: How discovered bonuses stay personal, can be widened into categories, and can be taught to others by a Magic Theory tractatus whose Quality meets twice the Bonus Level.
quotes: He may do this provided his Quality (Com + 6 + bonuses) for writing the book is at least twice the Bonus Level.

entries.title: The Great Elixir — Major Mystery Virtue
entries.requires: Virtue: Great Elixir (requires Unaging and Lesser Elixir)
entries.summary: Introduces the ritual by which an alchemist becomes an immortal being of Magic by creating and consuming a Great Elixir.
quotes: The magus must have both the Virtues Unaging and the Lesser Elixir.

entries.title: Preparing the Great Elixir
entries.summary: How the Great Elixir device is prepared, the enchantment spaces it takes, and the two unique Mystery effects (Become a Being of Magic, Grant Might) invested in it.
quotes: The Lesser Elixir uses up (Longevity Ritual level/10) enchantment spaces in the Great Elixir device.
the magus gains Magic Might equal to half (effect level–20)

entries.title: Testing the Great Elixir
entries.summary: Roll made when the maga drinks the potion; failure means a new dose and attempt, with Lab Text and cumulative bonuses to later attempts.
quotes: Simple Die + Stamina + Lesser Elixir Level + Reroll Bonus vs. Ease Factor of (Age/10, round up)
each attempt at the Great Elixir grants a cumulative +1 bonus to the roll, to a limit of the maga's Magic Theory

entries.title: Success! Effects of the Elixir
entries.summary: A successful Great Elixir permanently turns the magus into an immortal alchemical being of the Magic realm with a Might score from the potion.
quotes: He may be slain, but he will not die of lesser wounds, nor age or Warping.

entries.title: Improving the Elixir after Transformation
entries.summary: An immortal magus can brew a new Great Elixir to raise his Might; the Ease Factor stays fixed at the age at transformation and the cumulative bonus resets.
quotes: The Ease Factor to test the potion remains fixed at the age when the magus transformed

entries.title: Vitalizing Vis
entries.summary: Laboratory activity, akin to creating an invested device, that turns a living magical creature or plant into a Stirps. Accumulate seasonal points against a target Level based on its Magic Might; it also lets vis be removed from a living donor without killing it.
quotes: Vitalization Total: Intelligence + Creo + Vim + Hermetic Viresculture + Aura Modifier
Level of Effect: Magic Might
Vitalization costs one pawns of Vim vis per ten points of the Level of Effect (or fraction thereof)

related.text: Realms of Power: Magic p.62 Raven of Virtue

entries.title: Stirpes from Lesser Enchantment Vis
entries.summary: Lesser Enchantment Vis found in a self-reproducing living form can be Vitalized into a Stirps, using the level of its effect in place of Magic Might. Viresculture cannot create such vis, only let it propagate.
quotes: instead of Magic Might, use the level of the effect possessed by the vis

related.text: Realms of Power: Magic p.119 Lesser Enchantment Vis
Realms of Power: Magic p.124 Enriched Things of Virtue

entries.title: Invigorating a Stirps
entries.summary: One-season laboratory activity that lets a Stirps produce vis-bearing offspring for a number of breeding seasons, with a set yield of vis pawns per litter or crop and a chance that a pawn is itself an uninvigorated Stirps.
quotes: Invigoration Total: Intelligence + Creo + Form (Vim Requisite) + Hermetic Viresculture + Aura Modifier
Breeding Seasons: Invigoration Total / 10, rounded up
Number of Pawns of vis produced: (Magic Might/5) or (Level of Effect/5), rounded up

entries.title: Growing and Harvesting Vis
entries.summary: Describes harvesting pawns of vis from an Invigorated Stirps each breeding season, how its offspring are born Vitalized but uninvigorated, and how Stirps vis can be told apart with Intellego Vim.
quotes: All Stirpes born to a Stirps are naturally Vitalized but uninvigorated.

entries.title: Caring for Vis
entries.summary: Upkeep rules for an Invigorated Stirps: it must be kept in a magical Aura, the magus can supervise only a limited number of Stirpes, neglect or too little labor cuts the yield, and each Stirps needs a set amount of Labor Points.
quotes: A magus can only oversee the growth of a number of Stirpes (of any cultivar) equal to his Hermetic Viresculture Score.
It costs 12 Labor Points to care for each Stirps and its associated plants or animals.
Maximum Number of Stirpes fertile in a generation: Hermetic Viresculture

entries.title: Understanding Mechanica
entries.requires: Hermetic breakthrough research on Heron's Mechanica
entries.summary: A magus studies a mechanica for a season using the Investigating Enchantments rules to learn to use it as well as possibly gain Insight; also gives the accumulated breakthrough points suggested for Mutable Device.
quotes: Study Mechanica: Intellego Vim Lab Total + stress die vs. device spell or effect level
If the study total generated exceeds the level of the effect in the device, the magus understands the device sufficiently to use the device

entries.title: Major Breakthrough: Mutable Device
entries.summary: Hermetic enchanted devices whose invested effect can be altered later in the laboratory using vis, as long as the new effect shares Form and Technique and does not exceed the original level.
quotes: A mutable item is created like a Lesser Enchanted Device with the new Mutable Device property adding +10 to the device's level of effect.

related.text: ArM5 p.110 shape and material bonuses

entries.title: Integrating Mechanica: the integration process
entries.requires: Hermetic breakthrough research on Heron's Mechanica
entries.summary: After an Insight Lab Text exists, the magus makes Hermetic devices that duplicate a mechanica's effects to earn breakthrough points; building enchanted devices without vis breaks the Lesser Limit of Creation.
quotes: Incorporating the Mechanicians' ability to build enchanted devices without vis breaks the Lesser Limit of Creation (ArM5, page 80), requiring a Hermetic Breakthrough to achieve.

related.text: ArM5 p.80 Lesser Limit of Creation

entries.title: Major Breakthrough: Awakened Device
entries.summary: The breakthrough that allows Hermetic magi to awaken enchanted devices; it is a Major Breakthrough unless Mutable Device has already been discovered, in which case it is Minor.
quotes: If the researcher has already discovered Mutable Device, she builds upon existing work and the discovery becomes a Minor Breakthrough requiring 30 points.

entries.title: Major Hermetic Virtue: Awaken Device
entries.requires: Virtue: Awaken Device (after the Awakened Device breakthrough)
entries.summary: Hermetic procedure for awakening a simulacrum into a sentient Awakened Device: Magic Might from material and Magic Theory, vis cost, a Lab Total accumulated over uninterrupted seasons, and further enchanting for locomotion and communication.
quotes: Awakened Device's Magic Might: Material Base Points + Magic Theory
Awakened Device Lab Total: Creo + Form + Intelligence + Magic Theory + Aura
Awakened Device Level: Awakened Device's Magical Might + (Size x 5)

related.text: ArM5 p.97 Material and Size Table

entries.title: New Enchanted Device: Magical Armillary Sphere
entries.summary: Introduces the magical armillary sphere, an enchanted device that reports astrological conditions and eases calculation of Astrological Durations.
quotes: greatly assists in calculating and working with Astrological Durations

entries.title: Making an Armillary Sphere
entries.summary: Rolls to design and craft a precision mundane armillary sphere, with higher Ease Factors when another person designs or crafts it and a season of work required.
quotes: Stress Die + Intelligence + Astronomy vs. an Ease Factor of 12
Stress Die + Dexterity + Craft (Mechanisms or Clocks) vs. an Ease Factor of 12
The Ease Factors are reduced by 3 if copying an existing precision armillary sphere.

entries.title: Enchanting the Armillary Sphere
entries.summary: The vis needed to open the armillary sphere as an invested device and the two constant effects (Know the Heavens, Track the Heavens) that sense and keep it set to local astrological time.
quotes: The mechanism must be opened as an invested device, needing 15 pawns (base metal, x3 for skull sized), or 18 if constructed of silver, 30 for gold.

entries.title: Consulting the Armillary Sphere
entries.summary: Using the sphere halves the Ease Factor for Astrological Duration calculations; for a distant location the magus must know conditions there and adjust the sphere with a roll.
quotes: This halves the Ease Factor of Astrological Duration calculations.
To Adjust the Armillary Sphere: Stress Die + Intelligence + Astronomy vs. an Ease Factor of 9

entries.title: Bind Curse
entries.requires: Initiation: Bind Curse (Verditius Major Inner Mystery)
entries.summary: How a magus binds Minor or Major Curses (Flaw-like maledictions that last seasons or years) into enchanted items: base effect levels, Range, Target and Duration, triggers, Penetration and vis cost.
quotes: The basic enchantment effect level of a Minor Curse is level 25, and the basic enchantment effect level of a Major Curse is 50.
Each conditional trigger adds +3 to the final level of effect of the Curse.
Minor Curses last a number of seasons equal to the item's creator's Magic Theory score at the time of enchantment.

entries.title: Minor Curses
entries.requires: Initiation: Bind Curse (Verditius Major Inner Mystery)
entries.summary: A sample list of Minor Curses (weakened Characteristic, susceptibility to magic, twisted spine, warts, cataracts and more) with the game penalties each inflicts and the Arts used.
quotes: Hermetic magi suffer a –3 to their total Magic Resistance and must roll an additional botch die when botching using Hermetic magic.

entries.title: Major Curses
entries.requires: Initiation: Bind Curse (Verditius Major Inner Mystery)
entries.summary: A sample list of Major Curses (Aging, leprosy, burning flesh, brittle bones, demon's visage, lust for life, doubt) with the rolls and penalties each imposes.
quotes: A broken bone is treated as a Heavy Wound and heals normally.

entries.title: Removing Curses
entries.requires: Initiation: Bind Curse (Verditius Major Inner Mystery)
entries.summary: The ways a Curse can be lifted: waiting it out, a Perdo Vim spell matching its level, destroying or smelting the bestowing item (Minor Curses), or a powerful Magical or Divine creature.
quotes: The level of the Perdo Vim spell must match the final effect level of the Curse.

entries.title: The Lesser Elixir — Minor Mystery Virtue
entries.summary: Introduces the Lesser Elixir, a personal formula that improves the aging bonus of a Longevity Ritual by adding special ingredients; it cannot be made for another.
quotes: The Lesser Elixir increases the aging bonus of a Longevity Ritual by incorporating additional ingredients.
The Lesser Elixir requires Hermetic Alchemy.

entries.title: Creating the Lesser Elixir
entries.summary: Procedure for inventing a Lesser Elixir: perform the Longevity Ritual, spend a season adding an ingredient, and derive the Elixir Level from Elixir Points (capped by Magic Theory) to add to the Aging Bonus.
quotes: Elixir Points = Total of Points from Extra Ingredients
Aging Bonus = Longevity Ritual Modifier + Elixir Level

entries.title: Elixir Points
entries.summary: How ingredients earn Elixir Points from the Shape and Material Bonuses table; personally discovered items count double, but no single item may exceed the magus's Magic Theory.
quotes: No single item may have a bonus exceeding the alchemist's Magic Theory score.

entries.title: Repeating the Lesser Elixir
entries.summary: After an Aging Crisis the Lesser Elixir must be repeated on top of a fresh Longevity Ritual, and it may be reinvented with more ingredients for a further season.
quotes: If the magus suffers an Aging Crisis, the Lesser Elixir loses its effectiveness, and must be repeated.

entries.title: Opening the Arts in house Ex Miscellanea
entries.requires: House Ex Miscellanea tradition whose Major Virtue is an inborn Supernatural Virtue
entries.summary: Apprentices of certain Ex Miscellanea traditions need no minimum Intellego Vim Lab Total to keep the tradition's Major Virtue when the Arts are opened.

entries.title: Multiple Apprentices
entries.summary: Explains how many apprentices a magus can legally teach and the time cost, and gives magi Bonisagi the ability to use a second lab assistant so two apprentices can both assist in the lab.
quotes: magi Bonisagi can always successfully use a second lab assistant

entries.title: Working Together (Bonisagus lab assistants)
entries.requires: House Bonisagus (magi Bonisagi, their apprentices and familiars)
entries.summary: Magi Bonisagi may have one more lab assistant than the normal rules allow, and the text explains when they are willing to act as assistants to other magi.
quotes: magi Bonisagi can always have one more lab assistant than the normal ArM5 rules would allow a magus character to have

entries.title: Celestial Magic — Major Mystery Virtue
entries.summary: Introduces the Major astrological Virtue that includes and replaces Planetary Magic and adds wider Horoscopes, astrological Durations, a favorable hour for casting and astrologically linked enchantments.
quotes: This Virtue includes and replaces the benefits of Planetary Magic, which is a required prerequisite.

entries.title: Improved Laboratory Horoscopes
entries.summary: Celestial Magic lets the Laboratory Horoscope bonus apply to any laboratory activity, and also reduces the vis needed to open an invested device.
quotes: Stress Die + Intelligence + Astronomy vs. Three Times the Desired Bonus
subtract the Laboratory Horoscope bonus for the opening season from the number of pawns of vis required to open the device (minimum of one pawn)

entries.title: Astrologically Linked Enchantments
entries.summary: Enchantments can be linked to a single target by a Nativity Horoscope, giving a Lab Total bonus, or attuned to a cycle of signs, adding bonuses and opposing penalties to Penetration or frequency.
quotes: add the bonus for a Nativity Horoscope (+2)
The astrological cycle adjustment is the maga's Artes Liberales (Astronomy) score at the time she opens the device for enchantment

related.text: ArM5 p.84 Arcane Connection Bonus table

entries.title: Folk Witch Familiars
entries.summary: A witch binds one animal as a familiar in a season of laboratory work by beating a Binding Total built from the familiar's Size and Might.
quotes: FOLK WITCH FAMILIAR BINDING TOTAL: 10 + Familiar's Size + Familiar's Magic Might

related.text: Realms of Power: Magic, Book of Mundane Beasts
Houses of Hermes: Mystery Cults p.38

entries.title: Benefits of a Folk Witch Familiar
entries.summary: A familiar gains human Intelligence and languages, can assist in the kitchen for a Lab Total bonus, ages with its mistress, serves as an Arcane Connection both ways, and lets the witch dowse for it and see through its senses.
quotes: Familiar Bonus to Lab Total: Familiar's Intelligence + Familiar's Folk Witch Magic Theory

entries.title: Virtue: Spirit Familiar (bonding and cords)
entries.summary: Explains how to bind a spirit familiar, the bonding level formula for an insubstantial spirit, the renamed Hermes, Isis and Hekate cords, and how the spirit's Might-based Magic Resistance interacts with Parma Magica.
quotes: Spirit Familiar Bonding level: Spirit's Might + 25

related.text: Realms of Power: Magic ch.7 Magic Spirits

entries.title: Extended Material and Size Table (sidebar)
entries.summary: Table extending the Material and Size multipliers to huge rooms, structures and boundaries, giving the enchantment points needed for wood, soft stone and hard stone.
quotes: small room (3 paces by 3 paces) = Ind x 10

related.text: ArM5 p.97 Material and Size table

entries.title: Seasonal Vis Limits and Very Large Structures (sidebar)
entries.summary: Sidebar on getting around the seasonal vis limit for huge structures by having others open the component devices, using Verditius, Celestial Magic or Philosophic Alchemy to reduce the vis needed.
quotes: Since a magus is limited to twice Magic Theory pawns of vis in a single season in the laboratory

entries.title: Investigating the Structure
entries.summary: Rules for investigating the component devices in a normal lab, where the investigative Lab Total is halved, and the opacity of Architecture and Geometry enchantments to those without the Mystery.
quotes: the magus's investigative Lab Total is halved

entries.title: Periapt — Minor Mystery Virtue
entries.summary: Lets a magus create a seasonal Periapt Horoscope that acts as a single-use Lab Text for making astrological charged devices.
quotes: the charges resulting equal those that the magus would produce if he already had a Lab Text for the enchantment

entries.title: Creating a Periapt
entries.summary: Requirements for a Periapt Horoscope, the number of charges produced and the maximum Effect level, which depends on Artes Liberales (Astronomy).
quotes: Number of charges = Lab Total / 5 (rounded up)
Maximum Effect level = 5 x Artes Liberales (Astronomy) score

entries.title: Creating a Periapt Horoscope
entries.summary: The roll to prepare a seasonal Periapt Horoscope on an equinox or solstice, with failure and botch consequences for the whole season.
quotes: Stress Die + Intelligence + Astronomy vs. an Ease Factor of 9

entries.title: Planetary Magic — Minor Hermetic Virtue
entries.summary: Lets a magus build a Laboratory Horoscope for a planet and gain an Astrological Modifier to the Lab Total when creating an enchanted device, by rolling against an Ease Factor tied to the desired bonus.
quotes: Stress Die + Intelligence +Artes Liberales (Astronomy) vs. Three Times the Desired Bonus
Only one planet, and thus one bonus, may be invoked for any given season of work on an enchantment.

entries.title: Distractions from Planetary Magic
entries.summary: How lost laboratory time affects an Astrological Modifier: missing a whole day cancels the bonus.
quotes: she loses the benefit of the Astrological Modifier if she is ever forced to miss a whole day away from the laboratory

entries.title: Lab Texts and Planetary Magic
entries.summary: A Lab Text never carries an Astrological Modifier; any later season using it needs a fresh Laboratory Horoscope.
quotes: must create a new Laboratory Horoscope using Planetary Magic

entries.title: Tremere Enchanting Materials (Amber, Rhodocrosite, Opal)
entries.summary: Identifies amber, rhodocrosite and opal as the typical materials for minor Tremere items, their classification (semiprecious or precious) for enchantment cost, and the effects each assists.
quotes: Amber and rhodocrosite are semiprecious gems for enchantment cost calculation; opal is precious.

related.text: Shape and Material Bonus Table Additions

entries.title: Agyieus Pillars (enchanting bonuses)
entries.summary: Agyieus pillars sacred to Apollo may be enchanted and give listed shape and material bonuses for spirits, divination, sunlight, disease and protection.
quotes: The pillars may be enchanted, and provide the following shape and material bonuses: +2 invoking or controlling spirits, +3 divining the future, + 3 summoning sunlight, +5 cause or cure disease, and + 5 protection from hostile spirits.

entries.title: Metallic Arsenic (Material Bonuses)
entries.requires: Access to metallic arsenic (Verditius-style item crafting)
entries.summary: Describes arsenic smelted into a brittle metal for enchanted items and lists its material bonuses for different kinds of magic.
quotes: +8 magic that kills directly, without intermediate media.
+4 preservation of dead things from decay

entries.title: Dedicated Vis
entries.requires: Dedicated vis (a specific Technique and Form pairing)
entries.summary: Rare vis tied to a Technique and Form combination that counts as two pawns and gives bonuses in spell use, study and enchantment creation when used for that combination.
quotes: the vis may not be disaggregated into separate pawns of vis

entries.title: Dedicated Vis in Enchantment Creation
entries.requires: Dedicated vis (a specific Technique and Form pairing)
entries.summary: Dedicated vis grants double shape and material bonuses and counts as already-opened vis for enchanting the object it is in.
quotes: it gives double the normal shape and material bonus

related.text: The Mysteries Revised Edition, Ready-Opened Devices, page 41

entries.title: Insubstantial Vis
entries.summary: Special vis moved out of its native form loses its powers, so insubstantial vis (wind, scent, sound, light) must be kept in sealed vials or enchanted containers.
quotes: Transferring special, dedicated, or unique vis from its native form to another shape destroys the special powers contained in the vis.

entries.title: The Blood of Medusa (healing blood, vis, Longevity Ritual bonus)
entries.requires: Access to the Blood of Medusa at Epidauros
entries.summary: A renewable vis source whose blood heals wounds and diseases when drunk in quantity, and gives a Lab Total bonus when a small dose is used in crafting a Longevity Ritual.
quotes: If copiously drunk, the imbiber's Incapacitating Wounds are immediately reduced to Heavy and all later Recovery rolls for all current wounds succeed automatically.
If a smaller dose of the blood (4 pawns) is used in the crafting of a Longevity Ritual, +12 is gained to the Lab Total.

entries.title: The Hall of Repose at Epidauros (Longevity Ritual laboratory)
entries.summary: Describes the Hall of Repose, a shared laboratory specialized for longevity and healing that is used whenever a Tribunal-funded Longevity Ritual is made.
quotes: It may be used whenever a Tribunal-funded Longevity Ritual is created; the recipient is required to sleep in the hall.

entries.title: Writing Folios
entries.summary: Procedure and capacity limit for creating a folio in a season, based on the Colentes' combined Magic Theory, plus how much each Colens can copy, with a worked example.
quotes: The Colentes Arcanorum's combined Magic Theory scores are the maximum total of Lab Text magnitudes and tractatus Qualities that can be included in a single volume.
Folios: Colentes combined Magic Theory = Sum of Lab Text magnitudes and/or tractatus Qualities
A Colens may copy 12 magnitudes of Lab Texts per point in Profession: Scribe into a folio.

entries.title: Copying Folios
entries.summary: Rate at which a scribe copies a folio carefully or quickly, and the penalty to tractatus Quality for quick copying.
quotes: If a scribe is copying a folio carefully, he accumulates points equal to 6 + his Profession: Scribe score in a season.
If he copies the folio quickly, he gains 18 + 3 times his Profession: Scribe score in accumulated points per season.

entries.title: The Garden as an Hermetic Laboratory
entries.summary: Gives the garden's laboratory statistics (Virtues, Flaws, Characteristics, Specializations) and the rule that a season's equipment and ingredients are only available if a simple die roll comes in under the lab's Warping Characteristic.
quotes: If it is under the Laboratory's Warping Characteristic, then the equipment and ingredients for that activity are available and the season can progress as planned

related.text: Covenants p.118 Taking Over a Laboratory

entries.title: Ingasia's Forge of Hephaistos laboratory bonuses
entries.summary: The covenant's central forge has been converted into a shared Hermetic laboratory specialized for Rego magic and for creating enchanted items, within a Magic aura.
quotes: specialized to provide a +8 bonus to Rego magic and a +5 bonus to creating enchanted items

entries.title: Chthonic Magic (Ability)
entries.summary: A Supernatural Ability that substitutes for Magic Theory when doing dark or sinister lab work and adds to the vis a magus may use if it is Infernal.
quotes: You can substitute this Ability for Magic Theory when he is performing dark or sinister magic in the lab

entries.title: Replicating Formulae with Hermetic Magic
entries.summary: Describes how Rego Craft or Creo magic can assemble a reagent or theriac in an instant, the requisites to use, and the Finesse roll needed. Astrological inceptions cannot be duplicated this way.
quotes: The Ease Factor of this Finesse roll is the level of the formula + 9
A different spell is required for duplicating each formula.
Craft magic cannot duplicate astrological inceptions

entries.title: Enchanting a Familiar by Experimentation
entries.requires: A magus with a familiar being bound or empowered
entries.summary: Experimentation on a familiar bond adds the die as normal but risks tainting the bond.

entries.title: What Can Be Made? (faerie workshop commissions)
entries.requires: Access to the Devil's Lane workshops
entries.summary: Sets the seasonal work limit of each faerie merchant's workshop access, what Hermetic item projects the elves can duplicate, and the Talisman exclusion.
quotes: Each faerie merchant can commission in one season work equivalent to that done with a Lab Total of 100.
The workshop elves cannot create, attune, or enchant a Talisman.

entries.title: Hyperborean Enchantments (relics)
entries.summary: How a hymnist crafts relics: an enchantment total against an Ease Factor from the Powers' level, no vis but Warping instead, one season per Power, no size or material limits, plus the things hymn enchanting cannot do. Includes sample relic powers and how profaning or damage strips Powers.
quotes: Enchantment Total: Intelligence + Hymn Ability + modifiers + aura
Enchantment Ease Factor: (total level of Power(s) + modifiers) / 3
Furthermore, instead of using vis, the Hyperborean enchanter Warps his own body, at a rate of 2 Warping Points for every pawn of vis the enchantment would have needed

entries.title: Copying Lab Texts at the Spell Hall
entries.summary: Tremere copy spells freely from the archive; other magi must donate a Lab Text or vis. Texts cannot be removed and cannot be used to invent spells directly.
quotes: Generally, donating a Lab Text allows the character to copy a number of other texts equal to the magnitude of the donated spell.
Alternatively, a magus may donate a number of pawns of vis equal to the total magnitude of the Lab Texts he wants to copy.

entries.title: Adulis lighthouse laboratories
entries.summary: Describes using the old Adulis lighthouse as four sanctums and laboratories, and the distraction penalty that applies to laboratory activity if magic is used to keep the lighthouse lit.
quotes: any laboratory activity suffers a –5 penalty, unless the magus is Blind

entries.title: The Magestones of Verditius (portable Magic aura)
entries.requires: Possession of a magestone (Durenmar and Oculus Septentrionalis hold them)
entries.summary: Rare Creo Vim artifacts that each project a small Magic aura, allowing a covenant with no natural aura to give its magi lab work in a Magic aura for a limited number of seasons a year; Hermetic theory cannot replicate them.
quotes: Each stone manifests a Magic aura of 3, large enough to cover a large room or laboratory.
so that they are able to work in a Magic aura in their labs for up to two seasons every year
